name: Meemannavis
sum: Aptian ornithuromorph from the Xiagou Formation of Gansu with toothless jaw tips.
holotype: A partial skeleton with incomplete skull and neck and back vertebrae (number in O'Connor et al. 2021).
biology: The lower jaw and upper jaw tip are toothless; it may have had teeth further back in the upper jaw.
author: O'Connor et al. 2021

sources.text: O' Connor JK, Stidham TA, Harris JD, Lamanna MC, Bailleul AM, Hu H, Wang M, You H 2021. Avian skulls represent a diverse ornithuromorph fauna from the Lower Cretaceous Xiagou Formation, Gansu Province, China. Journal of Systematics and Evolution 60(5): 1172–1198. doi:10.1111/jse.12823

dates_note: No PBDB record; age from the stage named in the cited Wikipedia revision (Aptian), with ICS boundaries.
